note: This project ships no binary image assets. Every visual is generated at runtime in Canvas 2D, so each entry below is a procedural visual family with a single authoring source. 'status: approved' means the family is implemented, covered by tools/validation/landscape.ts, and visually reviewed in the retained captures under testdata/visual/.

assets.role: world substrate / ecological landscape (procedural, 60x60 field scaled to the canvas)

technical.dimensions: procedural 60x60 RGBA buffer, scaled to the visible world rectangle

visual_locks: palette roles
value structure (barren < fertile, waste ash above both)
no categorical biomes
no implied elevation/water/soil mechanics
deterministic per-cell microvariation

source.creator: Coding Agent, approved by Project Owner

assets.role: cosmetic non-colour channel on waste-loaded ground (procedural)

technical.dimensions: screen-space dots, one dot per load step

visual_locks: density rises with measured waste
never covers the whole world
cosmetic only; carries no ecological meaning beyond 'more waste'
consumes no simulation RNG

source.creator: Coding Agent
source.prompt_or_source_record: deterministic hash of cell index via landscape.ts::microTexture

assets.role: living organism marker — CURRENT/LEGACY RENDERER ONLY, not target phenotype art
assets.superseded_by: accepted phenotype direction (inherited recognizable body families, expressive naturalist/alien forms, organic silhouette variation)
assets.scope_note: Recorded only so a reviewer can tell an environmental constraint from an incidental property of today's code. This entry is NOT art-direction authority for organisms and must not be read as approving voxel morphology. The accepted phenotype direction replaces it. Requirements that survive that replacement — legibility at true scale, dormant-vs-active distinction, selection affordance, and ecological analysis that does not read morphology — are environmental requirements owned by assets/art-direction-brief.md, not morphological ones.

technical.dimensions: 2-4 px cells, span scaled by stored energy, on-screen unit = 2.2 x world scale

visual_locks: provisional: current voxel construction is incidental, not a durable lock
durable: life stays readable against every substrate value
durable: dormant and active are distinguishable without relying on hue
durable: ecological analysis must not be inferred from morphology

verification.approved_by: not applicable — provisional current-renderer record, superseded by the phenotype direction

assets.role: focus indicator for the selected organism (interaction affordance, not morphology)

technical.dimensions: 15 px radius halo, 7/9.5 px double ring, four diagonal ticks

visual_locks: brightest element on screen
must not occlude surrounding ecosystem detail
selection is read-only and must not alter the simulation

assets.role: read-only analytical waste view (procedural sequential ramp)
visual_locks: lifted dark end: a near-black ramp makes ordinary worlds look broken
brighter means more waste
no texture: analytical views suppress cosmetic detail
luminance carries the reading so it does not depend on hue

assets.role: read-only analytical nutrient A/B/C and combined views (procedural)
visual_locks: monotonic in its own field
exact-value reading preserved: no smoothing, no interpolation
legend/label support required for player interpretation
